captions.detailed: A mountain bike crankset assembly featuring a central dark-colored bottom bracket spindle. It is equipped with a dual chainring spider structure holding a large, scalloped black chainring. Two grey alloy crank arms extend in opposite directions, each terminating in a rotatable, dark-colored clipless pedal body mounted on a stub axle.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a mountain bike crankset. The assembly should feature a central bottom bracket spindle, a scalloped double chainring spider, two opposing alloy crank arms, and rotatable clipless pedal bodies at the ends of each arm.
captions.factory: Construct a fixed bottom bracket shell using a cylinder primitive. Create a rotatable crank spindle and chainring assembly by combining a central cylinder, radial spoke boxes, and a larger scalloped-edge cylinder for the chainring. Model the left and right crank arms using extruded tapered profiles or lofted shapes, and attach them to the spindle. Finally, define revolute joints at the ends of the crank arms to connect the rectangular box-based clipless pedal bodies.
